name: Implicit Differentiation for Sphere Tracing
aliases: Implicit Differentiation for Sphere Tracing Gradients
Sphere Tracing Gradients via Implicit Differentiation
definition: A method to compute gradients of the sphere tracing output with respect to input parameters (like SDF parameters) using implicit differentiation, avoiding the need to backpropagate through the iterative loop.
summary: Implicit differentiation for sphere tracing computes SDF parameter gradients by treating converged positions as fixed points, avoiding backpropagation through the iterative loop.
